ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and IoT sensor fusion platform that monitors urban environmental compliance and urban heat islands in real-time.
ideas.title: UrbanPulse Smart City Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Smart & Sustainable Cities track with hard geospatial engineering that appeals to municipal judges looking for operational prototypes.

ideas.pitch: A reinforcement learning and multi-agent routing engine that optimizes urban traffic signals to minimize city-wide carbon emissions.
ideas.title: EcoRoute AI Traffic Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines clear environmental impact metrics with a live, visual simulation demo that immediately grabs judges' attention.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computer vision application that detects and classifies urban waste accumulation in public spaces to automate municipal dispatch.
ideas.title: WasteLens Municipal Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a visible municipal pain point with a working end-to-end prototype from camera stream to actionable dashboard ticket.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting and automated response dashboard for localized microgrids to predict peak demand and prevent brownouts.
ideas.title: GridGuardian Energy Load Balancer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous time-series forecasting with calibrated confidence intervals, directly aligning with successful technical forecasting wins.

ideas.pitch: An acoustic and pressure anomaly detection platform for municipal water distribution networks to stop urban water loss.
ideas.title: AquaGrid Smart Water Leak Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Quantifiable resource savings combined with an interactive graph-based visualization makes the value proposition impossible to ignore.
